title: Abandoned carts
subtitle: Remind customers who left items in their cart before the sale goes cold.

banner.title: Abandoned cart list
banner.headline: Ready-to-close sales already in your store
banner.body: Follow customers who left items in the cart. Send a reminder and an offer that helps them come back and finish the order.
banner.more: A cart shows up here once a signed-in customer has left items for 24 hours, or the recovery sweep has already marked it abandoned. Guests are not listed — there is no email on those carts. Hide removes a row from this list only; it does not empty the shopper's cart.

daysAgo: {days, plural, =0 {Today} =1 {1 day ago} other {# days ago}}

kpi.heading: Abandoned cart performance
kpi.subheading: These figures are for the selected period. Recovered means the shopper checked out after abandoning, not that a reminder was sent.

statusDetail.title: Reminder status
statusDetail.noSend: No reminder has been sent yet.

empty.title: No abandoned carts
